environment.description: Python 3.11 service running on EC2 (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no application-layer inspection. Service is directly exposed on port 8080 via target group. No input validation middleware. Instance role has no restrictions on inbound payload content.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0
